title: More Than 50 Employers to Attend Laredo Hiring Fair Next Thursday
excerpt: Workforce Solutions for South Texas will host the free “Hiring Red, White and You” fair on Thursday, Nov. 19, at the Falcon Bank Event Center, with more than 50 employers and on-the-spot interviews.
content:
More than 50 employers will gather in Laredo next week for the “Hiring Red, White and You” job fair, organized by Workforce Solutions for South Texas, according to KGNS.

The fair takes place Thursday, Nov. 19, at the Falcon Bank Event Center on McPherson Road in Laredo. Veterans get priority entrance from 9 to 10 a.m.; the fair then opens to everyone at 10 a.m. and runs until 1 p.m. Admission is free.

Job seekers will be able to meet directly with employers and interview on the spot, KGNS reported.

“It just gives everyone a really good chance to explore different career options and also meet potential employers face to face,” Norma Garcia of Workforce Solutions for South Texas said.

Source: KGNS, “More than 50 employers to attend Laredo hiring fair next Thursday,” by Marissa Rodríguez Limón, Nov. 13, 2026. kgns.tv
